b: Andrej Karpathy had Claude Opus 5.5 turn the real United States into a Civilization-style map.

31 public data sources (Census, BEA, BLS, EIA, NOAA, USGS, etc.) reconciled onto a 25 km hex grid. GDP becomes Gold, industry specializations become districts (San Jose gets a Campus, Detroit is Motor City), workforce stats become citizens, and national parks/universities become wonders based on real rules.
19 interactive lenses, city views for 500+ metros, advisors, and a county explorer.

I asked Claude to populate a Civilization-style game map with real data from the US. Opus 5.5 downloaded and parse a ton of public data and 7 hours and 45K lines of code later… it works
